title: Northwest
summary: NORTHWEST', noun The point in the horizon between the north and west, and equally distant from each. NORTHWEST', adjective 1. Pertaining to the point between the north and west; being in the northwest

inlines.v: NORTHWEST', noun The point in the horizon between the north and west, and equally distant from each. NORTHWEST', adjective 1. Pertaining to the point between the north and west; being in the northwest; as the northwest coast. 2. Proceeding from the northwest; as a northwest wind.
